brace_model.title: Component Model for Steel Bracings
brace_model.intro: This web-based interactive interface computes the basic parameters for predictive modeling of steel bracings based on their basic material and geometric properties. For further information refer to Eurocode 8 Part 3.
brace_model.cross_section_type_help: Select the cross-sectional shape of the bracing member
brace_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
brace_model.steel_type_help: Select a standard steel grade or specify manually the material overstrength (Omega) and the nominal yield strength, fy)
brace_model.associated_member_lengths_help: Specify the associated member lengths as defined in the definition in the upper left corner

column_model.title: Predictive Model for Steel Wide-Flange Columns
column_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
column_model.member_loading_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
column_model.predictive_model_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

connection_model.title: Backbone Curve Plotter for Steel Components
connection_model.intro: Construct the backbone curve of beams with RBS and beams other-than-RBS. For further information refer to {reference}
connection_model.select_steel_profile_help: Here, you may choose to either select a W-Shape from the AISC database or input your own dimensions using the sliders below
connection_model.specify_member_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
connection_model.component_models_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

hss_model.title: Predictive Model for Hollow Structural Steel Columns
hss_model.select_hss_profile_help: Here, you may input dimensions using the sliders below
hss_model.member_loading_properties_help: Here you need to specify the beam full length (L), the beam unbraced length (Lb), which is defined as the distance from the column face to the nearest lateral brace, the expected yield stress, Fy of the steel material, the capping-to-yield ratio Mc/My, the expected residual strength ratio, K, and the ultimate rotation θu of the steel component.
hss_model.predictive_model_columns_help: Provided that the steel member is in double curvature

material_model.title: Material Model
material_model.intro: This web based interactive interface computes the hysteretic behavior of typical steels under inelastic cyclic straining. For further information refer to {hartloper} The uniaxial loading protocols are based on work by {castro}
material_model.intro_castro: de Castro e Sousa et al. (2020)
material_model.select_steel_material_help: Here you can select a steel material from the available list and with the sliders below you can check the sensitivity of the updated Voce and Chaboche constitutive model to the input material model parameters. The model is displayed based on four selected strain-based protocols for the same set of input model parameters.

brace_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Steel Bracings
brace_fragility.intro: This interactive module plots univariate and multivariate fragility curves for steel bracings of various types of cross sections. the multivariate curves depict the dependence of the fragility curve on member slenderness. For further information refer to {reference}.
brace_fragility.cross_section_help: Select the appropriate cross sectional shape of the bracing member to visualize the corresponding fragility curve.

column_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Wide-Flange Steel Columns
column_fragility.intro: This module plots univariate and multivariate fragility curves for wide-flange steel columns depending on their primary loading and geometric characteristics. For further information please refer to {reference}.
column_fragility.parameters_help: Please provide the imposed gravity-induced axial load ratio, Pg/Pyn and the web slenderness ratio, h/tw of the wide-flange cross section of the steel column.

connection_fragility.title: Fragility Curve Plotter for Steel Components
connection_fragility.intro: This tab introduces a web-based interactive module for visualizing fragility curves of Pre- and Post-Northridge beam-to-column connections. For further information refer to {lignos} and {ramirez}.
connection_fragility.figcaption: Pre-Northridge beam-to-column moment connection — definition of {l} and {db}.
